plugins.name: omniagents-typescript
plugins.description: TypeScript conventions: TSDoc + strict typing + testing rules

plugins.name: omniagents-design-patterns
plugins.description: Strict-typed Python 3.13+ design pattern catalogue plus deep-module design philosophy (software + system + codebase-design)

plugins.name: omniagents-writing
plugins.description: Measured-persuasion writing, markdown conventions, and blueprint format-clean HTML/SVG diagram generation

plugins.name: drawio
plugins.description: draw.io diagram skill (vendored from jgraph/drawio-mcp): author as Mermaid or draw.io XML with optional ELK auto-layout; export PNG/SVG/PDF with embedded XML or open via app.diagrams.net (draw.io Desktop optional, only for conversion/export)

plugins.name: code-review-graph
plugins.description: Code Review Graph MCP: tree-sitter knowledge graph tooling for impact analysis

plugins.name: codegraph
plugins.description: CodeGraph MCP: tree-sitter knowledge graph with symbol search, callers/callees, and impact analysis, auto-syncing on file changes (requires Node.js + npm on PATH)

plugins.name: context7
plugins.description: Context7 MCP: up-to-date library documentation lookup (requires CONTEXT7_API_KEY)

plugins.name: google-workspace
plugins.description: Google Workspace MCP: Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Docs, Contacts, Tasks, Chat (requires uv + Google OAuth creds)

plugins.name: playwright
plugins.description: Playwright MCP: browser automation and accessibility-tree page snapshots via Microsoft's @playwright/mcp (requires Node.js 18+)

plugins.name: notifications
plugins.description: macOS notifications on permission prompts, idle waits, and task completion via Notification + Stop hooks

plugins.name: omniagents-reviewer
plugins.description: Multi-specialist code reviewer: parallel correctness, security, performance, design, and testing agents with orchestrator dispatch and verification layer

plugins.name: doc-drift
plugins.description: Documentation drift detection hook: prompts Claude to review docs for stale references after code changes

plugins.name: omniagents-pedagogy
plugins.description: Incremental teaching skill: structured Socratic dialogue for deep code understanding via /coding-teacher

plugins.name: omniagents-unknowns
plugins.description: Blindspot pass: survey unfamiliar territory, surface unknown unknowns, and turn them into a sharper prompt before work begins

plugins.name: omniagents-iac
plugins.description: Infrastructure-as-code conventions: Terraform module patterns + hygiene and production Docker/compose rulebook

plugins.name: terraform-skill
plugins.description: Deep Terraform/OpenTofu skill by Anton Babenko (external, Apache-2.0) — failure diagnosis, state surgery, migrations. omniagents-iac:terraform routes deep dives here.
